title: Dynamo - mock SGLang lab
description: Full lab metric catalog, inference overview and live raw-series explorer. Real Dynamo, simulated inference; no physical GPU telemetry.

options.content:
**1300 metric families across 25 sections** (catalog refreshed 2026-10-09 18:57 UTC). Expand sections below the overview to see every family. Source and Instance filter the entire dashboard. The Raw metric explorer includes all live metric names, including histogram buckets, counts and sums, plus newly registered metrics.

Isolated routing experiments are excluded here; use the dedicated live experiment dashboard.

**Simulation boundary:** engine timing, KV use and GPU-slot accounting are simulated. There is no physical GPU utilization, power or VRAM telemetry. SLA-regression and power-planning metrics are not calibrated for this lab. **No data** means no samples were emitted or the feature is inactive, not zero.

panels.title: Overall QPS - completed requests
panels.description: Completed frontend requests per second, including success/error outcomes. Counted once at the frontend; never sum prefill and decode phase counts for overall QPS.

panels.title: Time to first token - p50 / p95 / p99
Input / output tokens per request - mean
Backend-reported cached fraction (includes transferred KV)
panels.description: Backend metadata counts transferred KV as cached in the fake decode engine. This is NOT an observed cross-request prefix-cache hit ratio.

panels.title: Prefill QPS - by worker
panels.description: Request arrivals per second at each worker's generate endpoint, filtered by role. Excludes management and KV-query endpoints. Includes retries or canaries if they use generate; not a success-only counter. Arrival timing differs from frontend completion timing.

panels.title: Request cancellation / rejection / TCP errors per second
Observed prefix-cache hit ratio - token-weighted
panels.description: Engine-observed local prefix reuse at the first successful prefill admission. Includes all prompt tokens in the denominator, including partial blocks. Excludes transferred decode KV, no-peer probes/warmup, admission retries and preemption re-prefills. Counters reset on worker restart. No traffic / no local lookups gives no ratio, not zero.

panels.title: Observed prefix-cache hit ratio - per worker
panels.description: Engine-observed local prefix reuse at the first successful prefill admission. Includes all prompt tokens in the denominator, including partial blocks. Excludes transferred decode KV, no-peer probes/warmup, admission retries and preemption re-prefills. Counters reset on worker restart. No traffic / no local lookups gives no ratio, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, dp_rank) (rate(sglang:simulated_prefix_cache_hit_tokens_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",job!="routing-experiment"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, dp_rank) (rate(sglang:simulated_prefix_cache_query_tokens_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",job!="routing-experiment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Predicted / observed prefix-cache hit ratio - mean
panels.description: Means of fractions, not token-weighted. Router predictions and engine observations are different populations: disaggregation can record multiple routing observations per frontend request; the engine records one initial prefill admission. Observed reuse excludes transferred decode KV.

panels.title: Observed prefix-cache reused / queried tokens per second
panels.description: Engine-observed local prefix reuse at the first successful prefill admission. Includes all prompt tokens in the denominator, including partial blocks. Excludes transferred decode KV, no-peer probes/warmup, admission retries and preemption re-prefills. Counters reset on worker restart. No traffic / no local lookups gives no ratio, not zero.

panels.title: Decode QPS - by worker
panels.description: Request arrivals per second at each worker's generate endpoint, filtered by role. Excludes management and KV-query endpoints. Includes retries or canaries if they use generate; not a success-only counter. Arrival timing differs from frontend completion timing.

panels.title: Cache tokens - all workers
panels.description: Engine measurements, independent of KV-event publication. Resident = reusable full-block prefix tokens; allocated = occupied token slots, including active/partial blocks; capacity = configured slots. Totals sum replicas, not deduplicated content. Pressure evictions exclude explicit cache clears (shown separately in the rate panel). Counters reset on worker restart. Cache is space-driven LRU, not TTL-based.

panels.title: Resident prefix-cache tokens / capacity - by worker
panels.description: Engine measurements, independent of KV-event publication. Resident = reusable full-block prefix tokens; allocated = occupied token slots, including active/partial blocks; capacity = configured slots. Totals sum replicas, not deduplicated content. Pressure evictions exclude explicit cache clears (shown separately in the rate panel). Counters reset on worker restart. Cache is space-driven LRU, not TTL-based.

panels.title: Pressure-evicted tokens - by worker (cumulative)
panels.description: Engine measurements, independent of KV-event publication. Resident = reusable full-block prefix tokens; allocated = occupied token slots, including active/partial blocks; capacity = configured slots. Totals sum replicas, not deduplicated content. Pressure evictions exclude explicit cache clears (shown separately in the rate panel). Counters reset on worker restart. Cache is space-driven LRU, not TTL-based.

panels.title: Cache eviction rate - tokens per second
panels.description: Engine measurements, independent of KV-event publication. Resident = reusable full-block prefix tokens; allocated = occupied token slots, including active/partial blocks; capacity = configured slots. Totals sum replicas, not deduplicated content. Pressure evictions exclude explicit cache clears (shown separately in the rate panel). Counters reset on worker restart. Cache is space-driven LRU, not TTL-based.
